name: merecatholicity
description: Build tooling for merecatholicity.com — the static site (docs/) and its Cloudflare Workers. Not a published package; this only manages the JS dev toolchain (Tailwind, esbuild, eslint, wrangler) behind a committed lockfile.

scripts.lint: eslint comments-worker/src/index.js docs/comments.js docs/nav.js docs/deeplink.js docs/flash.js docs/contact.js docs/bible-reader.js docs/away.js docs/index.js docs/sw.js app/
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run build:js && npm run build:css
